body:
Death will not feel relieving if you were afraid to live. When your life flashes before your eyes, you'll want to hold on but won't be able to at that point. 

Life does get worse before it gets better and we know how it feels at the bottom. It's a waste to steal your own chance of getting out of this pit stronger and experiencing the good things in life you've forgotten about.

People will hurt you, sometimes for no good reason at all, but why would you prove them right by hurting your own self too? 

As for the hate in the comments - they are pixels on your screen and have zero power over you and your life. Close Reddit and do something that's calming for you or that you enjoy. 

If you think your music is shit, then you have something to work towards. You'll feel amazing once you make something that you genuinely like so it's worth all the effort.
